lines.zh: 我迈着细腿在灌木下走
lines.en: I walk under the brush on thin legs.
I probe the way with my long bill.
I step over soft soil.
I shuffle on, a step at a time.
I go around the dead twigs.
I duck under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面小跑，稀疏丛林的落叶太厚。
lines.en: I scurry low; fallen leaves in the sparse jungle are deep.
My feathers puff at my sides.
I stop by the roots.
I turn and go another way.
I walk the brush's edge.
I look up, then down again.
I poke my bill into the soil.
I root through the dead leaves.
I tilt my head at the ground.
I hold still in the leaf litter.
I shake my round body.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，停在半空。
lines.en: I lift one foot and hold it in the air.
I rest in the brush.
My feathers are ruffled.
I probe the ground again.
I have no tail to wag.
I raise my long bill at you.
I shrink into the brush.
I cock my head at your shoes.
You are taller than the bushes.
I go back to hunting grubs.
Your steps startle me.
I quietly back half a step.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的鞋尖，随时要跑。
lines.en: I stare at your boot tips, ready to run.

lines.zh: 稀疏丛林里，我这么小一只。
lines.en: In the sparse jungle, I'm this small.
I shift my gaze to the soil.
I spring up in fright.
My feathers all mess up.
I dive into the brush.
My legs give and I crouch.
The pain makes me squeak.
I limp into hiding.
I tuck into the leaf pile.

lines.zh: 我的细毛竖着，腿一直发抖。
lines.en: My fine feathers stand up, legs trembling.
I wait a while before moving.
I dare not move.
What are you digging?
Something dug out of the soil.
I crane my head to look.
I touch it with my bill.
Can this be eaten?
I peck at it once.

lines.zh: 我用喙把果子拨到旁边。
lines.en: I push the fruit aside with my beak.
This does not look like a grub.
I will look for my own.
I lower my head to dig.
You touch me and I spring away.
I bolt into the brush.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我的绒毛全炸开。
lines.en: You touch me, and my down puffs out.
I slip past your legs.
The knock tips me aside.
I stop and look back.
Then I come out again slowly.

lines.zh: 丛林的小个子，一吓就跑散。
lines.en: A jungle little one scatters at a fright.
I shift behind the brush.
Small as I am, one dash and I'm gone.
Another slips out of the brush.
We tap bills.
It is a size smaller than I.
We dig side by side.
It stands beside me.
We slip into the leaf pile.
It gives a soft call.
Neither of us makes another sound.
It wanders off slowly.
I follow after it.
I peck up a grub.
I shake it in my bill.
I tip my head back and gulp.
One more peck — a bug.
I drop it.
I turn up something else.
I flick it aside with my bill.
I pin it with a claw.
I look up, then down again.
I keep digging.
I hear the grass move.
I raise my head.
I look toward the brush.
I freeze in place.
My body goes tight.
I shrink back a step.
This is no longer safe.
I need somewhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我探着长嘴，在灌木下找路。
lines.en: Long beak probing, I find my way under the brush.

lines.zh: 我后腿一弯，随时要钻进蕨丛。
lines.en: My legs bend, ready to bolt into the ferns.
Something is watching me.
I do not like that direction.

lines.zh: 我侧头又听了一下土里的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to the soil again.
I begin to edge sideways.
That shadow is too close.
One more moment and I run.
I crouch under the leaves.
Not a feather of me stirs.
It is not looking this way.
I listen to its steps.
I lower my head further.
It has moved to the other side.
I inch backward.
The brush hides me.
I am ready to dart out.
It has not gone far.
I lie flat against the soil.
When it leaves, I run.
My feathers match the soil.
The steps are still there.
I hold my breath.
It has come round this side.
I can tell how heavy it is.
My claws grip the soil.
It is only one bush away.
I have picked my escape route.
I hook it with a claw tip.
I leap and kick.
I peck at it.
I swing my head to knock it back.
I kick and pull back.
I leave a scratch on it.
I dash under it.
I peck once more.
It backs off.
I dive back into the brush.
That one was all panic.
My legs are shaking.
I watch it as I retreat.
It does not follow.
I stop to catch my breath.
I check around me.
I dart deeper in.
After the kick, I back away.
I kick up a spray of soil.
I vanish into the leaf pile.

lines.zh: 我从灌木缝里挤出来，先看四周。
lines.en: I squeeze from the bushes and check around first.
First I poke my head out.
My feathers are still dusty.
I stop on the fallen leaves.
I tilt my head at this place.
This brush will do.

lines.zh: 我从蕨根下钻出，抖了抖喙。
lines.en: I pop out from under a fern root and shake my beak.
I walk to the middle.
I hear a grub chirping.
I start rooting around.

lines.zh: 我站在落叶上，影子只有一小团。
lines.en: I stand on fallen leaves, my shadow a small patch.
I retreat to the brush's edge.
Fire swept by and curled my feathers.

lines.zh: 我滚下土坡，羽毛沾满泥。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, feathers caked with mud.

lines.zh: 水呛进我的鼻孔，我乱扑腾。
lines.en: Water floods my nostrils, and I thrash.
The blast throws me into the brush.

lines.zh: 我这么小，一吓就往草里钻。
lines.en: So small, one fright sends me into the grass.
Spell light sends me darting.
Hunger keeps me from digging.

lines.zh: 雷劈中旁边的树，我缩成一团。
lines.en: Lightning splits the tree beside me, and I curl up.
I fall where there is no ground.
